Contextual Information:
The median time to reach a decision under Depop’s internal complaints mechanism reflects the operation of a dedicated appeals function. Appeals are reviewed by trained moderation specialists who are responsible solely for handling internal complaints and conducting end-to-end reassessment of the original enforcement decision.

This dedicated structure, combined with extended business-hour coverage and established review workflows, supports timely and consistent decision-making. Both decisions that uphold and those that reverse the original action follow the same review process and service-level expectations, which contributes to consistency in resolution times.
